text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Today, Akari and {0} have arranged to hang out together,
but Akari has arrived at the meeting point a little early.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}と遊ぶ約束をしたアカリは、
早々に待ち合わせ場所に来ていた。

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to spend some quality time with {0}!
Who knows what might happen...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃんと二人っきりで遊べるなんて、
楽しみ～
いろいろと期待しちゃうな～

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
I messed up last time, with the whole lingerie incident...
But as long as I don't take him to a place like that,
it should be fine this time, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この前、
下着屋さんに行った時は失敗しちゃったけど、
ああいうお店に行かなければ、
大丈夫だよね。

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
It's not like we haven't gone out to do stuff together before,
but this is the first time we've met up just to hang out.
My first time with {0}... I can't wait!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃんと一緒に出かけることは、
たくさんあったけど、
二人で遊ぶのは初めてだよね。
お兄ちゃんとの初めて……
楽しみだな～

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
Where should I take him?
I wonder what kind of places he'd enjoy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どこに行こうかな？
お兄ちゃんがよろこぶ場所って、
どこだろ？

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh... I do hope he shows up soon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～！　
お兄ちゃん、早く来ないかな～

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
...H-huh?
This is when we said we'd meet up, right?
There's no sign of him anywhere...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
あれ？
もう約束の時間だよね？
お兄ちゃん、
ぜんぜん来ないな～

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
It's not like {0} to be late for an appointment...
But I guess everyone messes up once in a while!
I'll wait a little longer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃんが遅刻なんて珍しいけど……
たまには、こういうこともあるよね。
もうちょっと待ってみよ～

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
He's still not here...
It's long past the time we said we'd meet up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだ来ない……
約束の時間、
とっくに過ぎちゃったのに……

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
I can't imagine he'd just cancel on me
without even sending a message...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃんがなんの連絡もしないで
約束を破るとも思えないけど……

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
C-could it be
something serious happened to him?!
He could be in danger!
text_block_list.orig_text:
も、もしかして、
なにか事件に巻き込まれてるとか！？
お兄ちゃんが危ない！？

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? {0}?
Are you okay?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ……
お兄ちゃん？
大丈夫なんですか？

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
W-well of course I'm flustered!
Do you have any idea how late you are?
I thought something had happened to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんのことって……
こんなに遅れたんですから、
何かあったんじゃないんですか？

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
It was no big deal...? Really...?
So you're not even going to tell me why you're late?
text_block_list.orig_text:
大したことじゃない、
ですか……？
理由、
教えてくれないんですね？

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
I was really worried about you, you know!
I thought you might have been injured, or worse...!
I really thought you were in trouble...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、すっごい心配したんですよ！
お兄ちゃんが大怪我したんじゃないか、
とか……
本当に心配してたんです……

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
And now you show up and you won't even explain yourself?!
You're terrible! I'm not talking to you anymore!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなのに、
なんの説明もしてくれないなんて、ひどいです！
お兄ちゃんなんて、
もう知らない！

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*
Maybe running away was excessive...
But it's his fault, not mine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、はぁ！
思わず走って逃げちゃった……
でも、お兄ちゃんが悪いんだもん！

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
*pant*...
I ran all this way to the spot with my favorite view
But I wish I could have come with {0} instead...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
ここからの景色が好きだから、
来ちゃったけど……
どうせならお兄ちゃんと一緒に見たかったな～

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
All he did was show up late...
Maybe I blew up a bit too much...
I'm sure he had his own reasons...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……遅刻しただけなのに、
ちょっと怒りすぎちゃったかな？
お兄ちゃんにも事情があっただろうし……

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I've decided. I'll go back and apologize!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
やっぱり、
戻って謝ってこよう！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAGGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whaaaa?!
A monster?!
O-oh no, what do I do?! This is the worst timing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、ええ！？
魔物！？
ど、
どうしよう、
こんな時に！？

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
I've got to run!
A-although... it doesn't actually look that strong,
so maybe I should fight it? ...No, running is definitely the safer—
text_block_list.orig_text:
早く逃げなきゃ！
で、でも、
そんなに強そうじゃないし、
戦ったほうが……？
ううん、
やっぱり逃げたほうが──

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAGGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
A-aaaahhh!
Nooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
わぁ！
来ないで～！

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
{0}?!
You took the monster's attack for me...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃん！？
私をかばってケガを……！

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text: It's only a flesh wound...? B-but...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大したケガじゃないって……
でも！

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Th-that's what we're doing now, huh?!
I'm running, I'm running, you can stop pulling me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
ま、まずは逃げるんですか！？
わかったから、引っ張らないで～

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
I don't see the monster chasing us...
I think we managed to lose it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物、追ってきませんね。
なんとか逃げ切れたみたいです……

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
U-um, listen, {0}...
Thank you so much for saving me.
And, um... I'm sorry for getting mad at you back there.
choice_data_list: I'm the one who should say sorry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あの、
お兄ちゃん……
助けてくれて、
ありがとうございました。
それから……
さっきは怒って、
ごめんなさい！

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not your fault at all.
I am curious about why you were late, but...
Oh, I didn't mean it like—
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
お兄ちゃんは悪くないですよ。
遅刻した理由は気になりますけど……
あっ、
責めてるわけじゃ──

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What's this package?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんですか、
その包み？

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
A present for me?!
You were running late because you bought this on the way?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私へのプレゼント！？
これを買ってたから、
遅刻したんですか……

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
So you didn't want to explain because you were hoping to
surprise me... I'm so sorry, I didn't even think of that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ビックリさせたかったから、
理由も言えなかったんですね。
ごめんなさい。
私、
全然気づけなくて……

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the present, {0}!
Is it OK if I open it already?
I wonder what's inside!
text_block_list.orig_text:
プレゼント、
ありがとうございます！
さっそく開けてもいいですか？
中身はなんだろ～？

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
This is... the lingerie you picked out for me before!
Oh, that's so lovely!
I'll think of you whenever I put it on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ……
この前選んでくれた下着！
うれしいです！
お兄ちゃんだと思って、
大事にはきますね。

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text: But... I can't believe you went back there on your own...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
よく男の人一人で買えましたね？

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You asked Yori to help you out?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え！？　
お姉ちゃんに手伝ってもらった……？

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. Is that right.
You were hanging out with my sister before meeting up with me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふーん、
そうですか。
私と遊ぶ前に、
お姉ちゃんと……

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
That does it! I'm gonna become the cutest girl in the world!
Even cuter than Yori! You wait and see!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
やっぱり世界でいちばんかわいくなります！
絶対に！　
お姉ちゃんよりもです！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: For some reason, Akari suddenly seemed more determined than ever.
text_block_list.orig_text: 新たな決意を抱くアカリであった。
